scripts.build: bun run --filter='@tasks-app/api-client' build && bun run --filter='@tasks-app/api' build && bun run --filter='@tasks-app/web' build
scripts.deploy: bun run build && flyctl deploy --config apps/api/fly.toml --dockerfile apps/api/Dockerfile
scripts.clean:deps: rm -rf node_modules && bun run --filter='*' clean:deps && rm -f bun.lock
